newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open up 0.20 to 0.40 cent.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open up 0.20 to 0.40 cent.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open up 0.20 to 0.40 cent per pound Wednesday, as LME was largely featureless in dull, overnight trading.
Dealers see copper needing to take a breather and consolidate for a while because technical indicators still show the market is slightly overbought following last week's sharp run up.
LME stocks fell a modest 450 tonnes Wednesday to 136,575 tonnes.
COMEX stocks on Tuesday rose 1,907 short tons to 42,397 short tons.
On overnight ACCESS COMEX July copper last traded at 118.20 cents, off 0.20 cent from Tuesday's close.
The LME backwardation narrowed slightly overnight to $67/$71.
